def ref_fib(n: int) -> int:
    """Obviously-correct iterative reference for standard Fibonacci F0=0, F1=1."""

def test_property_addition_formula(n, k):
    # F_{n+k} == F_n * F_{k+1} + F_{n-1} * F_k for n >= 1; check n>=1 case
    # plus F_{0+k} == F_k base.
    if n == 0:
        assert fib(n + k) == fib(k)
    else:
        assert fib(n + k) == fib(n) * fib(k + 1) + fib(n - 1) * fib(k)
